name: app-white-crypto-wallet-home-and-convert-screens-with-black-floating-button
title: White Crypto Wallet with Floating Exchange Button
whatItIs: Two white phones on light grey: a wallet home with a balance card and sparkline, Deposit, Withdraw and Buy actions, and a crypto market list with green and red changes; and a Convert screen with sent and receive fields, a black Convert button, rate details and a history list, both with a raised black exchange button in the tab bar.
whatItMeans: Clean white cards with black actions and semantic green and red make market data easy to scan.
techniques: Raised black button in the tab bar for the main action
Small sparkline in the balance card
Two-field converter with a black CTA
Coin icons in their brand colours as the only colour

vocabulary.definition: A tab bar item lifted above the bar as the primary action.
A tiny line chart shown beside a figure.
A two-field form for exchanging one asset for another.
